Name: Brace
Description (Fluff): You draw a deep breath, steeling yourself for the struggle ahead.

Name: Battle Maneuver
Description (Fluff): The foundation of martial training, every military recruit and self-taught fighter learns how to attack in many strategic ways, knocking opponents off-guard and carving the way for victory.
Builder Notes: When you learn this, choose features that apply to the attack (see Features sheet). Points: Level 1: 3 basic; Level 2: 6 basic; Level 3: 9 basic/advanced; Level 4: 12 basic/advanced.

Name: Soulblade
Description (Fluff): Through mystical training, force of will, or some other mental regimen you have unlocked the ability to forge your spiritual force into a solid weapon.
Effects: When you learn this, choose a specific type of weapon. For 0 AP at any time you can create a weapon of the chosen type, appearing in your hand(s). If the weapon leaves your hands it disappears; if thrown it disappears after striking its target.

Name: Lay On Hands
Target: Yourself or an adjacent willing creature
Effects: Do each in order: 1. Remove 1 stack of each Poison effect affecting the target. 2. Remove up to 2 stacks of Bleeding. 3. Target heals 1 Health, or 2 if the discarded card was a Heart.

Name: Bear School - Boulder Toss
Action: 0 AP - Interrupt (you hit with an attack to grapple a creature)
Effects: End the grapple and throw the target up to [half your Brawl Skill Total] meters in a straight line. If thrown into a sturdy object, the target strikes it (3 + [your Body] Physical damage to both). If thrown through a creature's space, make a Brawl attack against that creature's Dodge; if it hits they are struck for the same damage. Target lands in front of the obstacle.

Name: Healing Magic
Effects: The target heals 1 Shallow Health, plus an extra Shallow Health for each Heart discarded.
Builder Notes: When you learn this, choose features that apply to the Spell (see Features sheet). Points: Level 1: 1 basic; Level 2: 4 basic; Level 3: 8 basic/advanced; Level 4: 11 basic/advanced.

Name: Spectral Spiderwebs
Target: Up to X + 1 creatures within [Theurgy Skill Total] meters
Effects: Make a Theurgy spell attack against each target's Dodge Defense. If the attack hits, the target is Slowed 4 + [Spades] times. Discarded cards are counted in the attack's suit pool.

Name: Tiger School - Storm of Blades
Description (Fluff): As a fighter perfects the art of two-weapon fighting, their style takes on a certain beauty. Every step carries one attack into another, blades dance about in a mesmerizing rhythm, and anyone who stands still to watch is sure to be cut to ribbons.
Condition: You are wielding two non-shield weapons
Effects: Once per round, right after you make an attack with one of your weapons, you may spend 1 AP to Repeat it with your other weapon.

Name: Profession
Description (Fluff): You benefit from basic training in a practice or profession, giving you solid fundamentals in a valuable skill.
Choice Effects:
Apothecary: You have Good Luck on flips to identify or recall basic facts about herbs, medicines, and common ailments.
Artisan: You have Good Luck on any flip to establish or manage your craft in an official, professional sense, such as dealing with a local guild or other legal entity.
Busker: You have Good Luck on flips to put on small street-side or tavern performances, such as playing in exchange for room and board.
Fisher: You have Good Luck on flips to fish, wait calmly and patiently, and resist the harmful effects of alcohol.
Gatherer: You have Good Luck on flips when exploring and searching for food and water.
Grifter: You have Good Luck on flips to run grifts or confidence games, as well as flips to escape legal or other consequences of doing so.
Merchant: You have Good Luck on flips to negotiate transactions, locate a buyer or seller for rare goods, and understand basic economic forces.
Sailor: You have Good Luck on flips to swim, use rope, and operate a ship.
Tactician: You have Good Luck on any flip related to military strategy, tactics, and organization. This applies even to small, ragtag groups like bandits.
Theologian: You have Good Luck on flips to recall or understand religious elements, as well as to explain or preach them to others.
Builder Notes: Each time you learn this Technique, choose one of the following. Picking a profession below narrows this card down to just that profession's benefit and prereq; the full list stays visible until a pick is made, for comparing options.
